title: Prompt prefix stable across turns
goal: The system text and tool schemas come first and do not change between turns
acceptance: A committed test builds two Misato asks a minute apart with the same tools and asserts the prefix (system text and tool schemas) is byte-identical up to the per-turn context
If the prefix moves, the volatile part (clock, inbox, memory) moves after it
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-16: one test over misatoAsk, a reorder if it fails. Not a measurement.
